Question:
In \(\triangle ABC\), \(\angle ABC\) is a right angle. The sides of \(\triangle ABC\) are the diameters of semicircles as shown. The area of the semicircle on \(\overline{AB}\) equals \(8\pi,\) and the arc of the semicircle on \(\overline{AC}\) has length \(8.5\pi.\) What is the radius of the semicircle on \(\overline{BC}?\)
